messages.author: Nadia Okafor
messages.text: RPT-880 is 7 points after the boundary analysis, not the 4 in last week's export. I have 2 points left this sprint — enough for the verification, not the fix.

messages.author: Desmond Quayle
messages.text: A hand-adjusted extract is not a certified figure under schedule 3; do not offer it. Moving the 6 May date is my call and nobody has asked.

messages.author: Folake Adeyemi
messages.text: The call-off is approved. A service credit for a missed submission would be a separate approval from me — it is not in AP-WP-0107.
